_comment: demle.me titles produced by the curation pipeline. AiPulse is also built into
publication.py; the entry here is the one that is read, so the title can be repointed
without a code change. Atolye is deliberately absent: it is hand-authored and the front
page renders it from a static description.
A malformed file is IGNORED rather than fatal (this is read on the publish path), so a
typo here costs the second title, never the daily issue.
